title: FTL: A new operating system for clouds
why_read: A new systems-level OS design targeting cloud infrastructure is a substantive engineering topic worth engineers' attention.
analysis: FTL appears to be a proposed or implemented operating system designed specifically for cloud environments, which is a meaningfully different design space than general-purpose OSes like Linux. Cloud-native OS designs often rethink assumptions around multi-tenancy, scheduling, isolation, and resource sharing at a lower level than container runtimes. The discussion volume suggests engineers found enough substance to debate design tradeoffs, which is a good signal for technical depth.
